title: Fund
description: A financial account or grouping a government uses to account for resources that are restricted, designated or otherwise managed for particular purposes. A fund is persistent: it appears in many budgets across many fiscal years, while a `BudgetLine` belongs to one budget. schema.org has no equivalent, so `gs:Fund` is minted.

@id.description: This fund's own stable identifier. It does not change from one fiscal year to the next.

name.description: The fund's official name, e.g. 'Building Inspection Fund'.

alternateName.description: Other names the fund is known by.

description.description: What the fund is for and how it is used.

identifier.description: Scheme-qualified identifiers, such as the fund number in the government's accounting system. A fund number is only unique within that system.

sourceDataset.description: The `Dataset` this record was published as part of.
